wa_mount_crowder_northeast_ridge.approach: Reached only by first climbing Mount Crowder by its Southwest Route, from the col between Phantom Peak and Crowder, and continuing down the far side; there is no separate trailhead approach to this ridge on its own.

approach_logistics.trailhead: No separate trailhead — over Mount Crowder by its Southwest Route

road.name: Ruth Creek Rd / Hannegan Pass Rd (FR-32)
road.status: Seasonal USFS road, subject to washout
road.driveNote: From WA-542 (Mt. Baker Hwy), follow FR-32 about 5.3 mi to road's end at the Hannegan Pass Trailhead; recent storm damage has at times restricted vehicles to around mile 5.2 — check current Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF alerts before you go.
road.seasonalGate: Typically opens once snow clears in early-mid summer and closes with the first significant fall snow.

bivy.name: Pickell Pass
bivy.notes: Open camp at the pass at the foot of the ridge, used by traverse parties who climb Crowder by its Southwest Route and descend this ridge to the pass.
bivy.permit: North Cascades NP backcountry permit (cross-country zone)
